verified_facts.text: Tropica Island Resort sits in a private sheltered bay on Malolo Island, with views over the nearby islands of the Mamanucas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled into a private sheltered bay on beautiful Malolo Island, Tropica Island Resort offers breathtaking views over the nearby islands of Fiji

verified_facts.text: Tropica is an island resort exclusively for adults, in a private bay in the Mamanuca Islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tropica Island Resort is an adults only, boutique island retreat nestled in a private bay in Fiji

verified_facts.text: The resort blends contemporary comfort with traditional Fijian design.
